question: Who are said to attain supreme Brahman as those versed in all scriptures?
premises: They are described as versed in all scriptures.
This attainment is attributed to that group.
inference: The verse says those versed in all scriptures attain supreme Brahman.
uncertainties: The grammatical subject is implied by context of prior verses.
plain_english: Those versed in all scriptures attain supreme Brahman.
